title: No Apple Watch Complications
body: The app is good overall, but it doesn’t have an Apple Watch complication. I can’t even add a simple complication for it to open the app and quickly set a habit as done from my Apple Watch, which is a perfect use case for such an app. Disappointed that an app that has been developed for so many years doesn’t have such a useful easy to implement feature yet.
author: Samir.
